svg.text: Every color pushed 35% of the way to full saturation and brightness, then each hue slid toward the brightest hue nearby,
never so far it crowds a neighbor.
Each ring is a Default color, each dot the palette's; the arrows are the moves between, in order:
HUE AND COLORFULNESS: angle is hue, distance out is chroma
Default's ramp polarized 50%: grounds toward the mode's pole, inks toward the other.
